summary: 26-year-old Kansas man suffering severe high altitude sickness at the Boulder Field on Longs Peak, ill since attempting to summit the day before; a park trail crew assessed him within 30 min and St. Anthony Flight for Life helicopter flew him to Medical Center of the Rockies; doctors said the care likely saved his life
location: Boulder Field, Longs Peak, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: RMNP rangers/trail crew; St. Anthony Flight for Life
notes: Incident date pinned to Fri 2011-07-22: report filed Mon Jul 25 says rangers were notified "last Friday morning"; weekday-verified.
